title: Wso2am: Hostname verification in Apache ZooKeeper ZKTrustManager falls back to reverse DNS (PTR) when… (CVE-2026-24281)
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package affects hostname verification in Apache ZooKeeper's ZKTrustManager. When IP Subject Alternative Name (SAN) validation fails, the verification falls back to reverse DNS (PTR) lookup. This fallback allows attackers who can control or spoof PTR records to impersonate ZooKeeper servers or clients by presenting a valid certificate for the PTR name. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.4 and is fixed in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
